response.sql: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS source, COUNT(*) AS spatial_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), measured AS (SELECT source, spatial_count, SUM(spatial_count) OVER () AS total_count, AVG(spatial_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM source_counts) SELECT source, spatial_count AS count, 100.0 * spatial_count / total_count AS share_percent, spatial_count - average_count AS above_average FROM measured WHERE spatial_count > average_count

assumptions.assumption: Coverage counts spatial records, and a NULL funding source forms its own group.

alternatives.interpretation: Coverage counts distinct projects that have spatial data.
alternatives.sql: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS source, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), measured AS (SELECT source, project_count, SUM(project_count) OVER () AS total_count, AVG(project_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM source_counts) SELECT source, project_count AS count, 100.0 * project_count / total_count AS share_percent, project_count - average_count AS above_average FROM measured WHERE project_count > average_count
